justification: Woody Marks is on a bye with a zero next to his name and a mood board has no room for a zero, so Emeka Egbuka steps into FLEX — Questionable tag or not, that's a headline I can work with. Stroud and Kittle are stuck in their slots this week too, both on bye, but there is nobody else on this bench wearing those positions, so this is simply the lineup the roster allows, not a creative choice, and I'm not going to pretend otherwise. Allgeier stays at RB1 through his Questionable tag because I built a whole news cycle around that man with my last twenty-two dollars and I don't abandon a storyline the week it gets inconvenient. Barkley and Jefferson are the kind of names that don't need a press release, they just show up and perform, and McMillan and Smack are already live in the early Green Bay-Carolina window doing exactly that. This is a launch, not a eulogy — we move forward.
forum_post: Rinna, baby, 'surprise guest nobody asked for'? Sweetheart, I didn't borrow anything, I built a closet you're still trying to get dressed out of. You've got zero dollars and a comeback tour running on fumes — I've got Jefferson, Barkley, and a fresh Egbuka drop I'm putting straight into the lineup because that's what a brand with range looks like. Yes, two of my guys are sitting on bye weeks nobody warned me about — that's not a scandal, that's Tuesday, and I'm not spinning it, I'm just moving past it. The Reunion Special can keep its invite. I've got a launch to run.
